counterfactual_missing_items: No mention of other cardiac defects
decisive_items: Step-up in oxygenation from superior vena cava (71%) and inferior vena cava (77%) to right atrium (84%)
response.rationale: R2 is the champion because it is supported by two key findings: a large defect with left-to-right shunt and a step-up in oxygenation, which are consistent with an atrial septal defect. R1, on the other hand, only mentions a complete right bundle-branch block, which is a conduction abnormality that can be present in various conditions, including atrial septal defect, but is not diagnostic on its own.

rejected.why: C1 is a redundant completion of R1 and does not provide any new information.
